ONCOLOGY GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Age/Sex: 40 year old male
Specimen Type: Bone Marrow Aspirate
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Evaluation for suspected myeloma in patient with plasmacytoma. Assessment requested for potential progression to multiple myeloma.

TEST ORDERED
Myeloma FISH Panel
- t(11;14) CCND1/IGH
- t(4;14) FGFR3/IGH
- t(14;16) IGH/MAF
- del(17p) TP53
- del(13q) RB1
- Hyperdiploidy assessment

TEST METHODOLOGY
Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) analysis using plasma cell enrichment by CD138+ magnetic bead selection followed by cytoplasmic immunoglobulin light chain staining.

RESULT
TEST NOT PERFORMED

REASON FOR TEST CANCELLATION
Insufficient plasma cells in bone marrow aspirate specimen. Flow cytometry analysis revealed only 1% plasma cells in the submitted sample. A minimum of 10% plasma cells is required for reliable FISH analysis after CD138+ enrichment.

COMMENT
The submitted bone marrow aspirate contains inadequate numbers of plasma cells (1%) for FISH analysis. This low plasma cell percentage precludes meaningful assessment of myeloma-associated cytogenetic abnormalities including IGH translocations, hyperdiploidy, and high-risk deletions.

In patients with plasmacytoma being evaluated for progression to multiple myeloma, cytogenetic analysis provides important prognostic information. The inability to perform this testing limits risk stratification capabilities.

RECOMMENDATIONS
No further testing is possible on the current sample due to insufficient plasma cell content. If clinically indicated, consider:
- Repeat bone marrow biopsy targeting areas of increased disease burden
- Evaluation of alternative sites if focal lesions are present
- Correlation with serum/urine protein electrophoresis and free light chain analysis
- Clinical and radiographic monitoring for disease progression

This result has been reviewed and electronically signed by:
[redacted name], MD, PhD
Director, Oncology Genetics Laboratory
[redacted location] Medical Center
